name: cookiesStorage
description: A storage adapter implementing StateStorage interface for cookie-based persistence using js-cookie library.
usage_guidelines: Use for persisting state in cookies (auth tokens, preferences).
Compatible with state management libraries expecting StateStorage interface.

return_value.description: Storage adapter object with getItem, setItem, and removeItem methods.

setItem.type: (name: string, value: string, expires?: number | Date) => void
setItem.description: Sets cookie with optional expiration (defaults to 1 day).

Do: Use for auth tokens and preferences
Dont: Don't store sensitive data without encryption
Don't store large amounts of data
